dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans with VA-guaranteed home loans at risk of default, loan holders, real estate brokers, and homeless veterans utilizing supportive housing programs.
dimensions.evidence: authorize the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to take certain actions in the case of a default on a home loan guaranteed by the Secretary

dimensions.assessment: Provides substantial foreclosure prevention options, partial claim debt relief up to 25-30 percent of unpaid principal, and increased homeless service funding.
dimensions.evidence: the amount of a partial claim under this section with respect to a loan guaranteed described in subsection (a) may not exceed 25 percent

dimensions.assessment: Increases authorizations for comprehensive service programs for homeless veterans to $344 million for each of fiscal years 2025 and 2026, and $257.7 million annually thereafter.
dimensions.evidence: $344,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 and 2026. $257,700,000 for each fiscal year thereafter through fiscal year 2030.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new Partial Claim Program, mandates specific loss mitigation sequences, requires congressional reporting, and amends title 38 authorizations.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall carry out a program, to be known as the 'Partial Claim Program', under which the Secretary may make a partial claim

dimensions.assessment: Includes permanent statutory loan authority changes, a 5-year sunset on the Partial Claim Program, and multi-year funding authorizations through 2030.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may not make a partial claim under this section after the date that is five years after the date of the enactment of this section.

importance_detail.rationale: The act authorizes the VA to take loss mitigation actions to avoid home loan foreclosures, establishes a five-year Partial Claim Program for loans in default, requires a report on real estate representation for veterans, and increases funding authorizations for homeless veteran service programs.
